title: Thai Airways - Any Upcoming Sales?
body:
Looking to book a return flight from Sydney to Bangkok for mid 2027.
Keen to hear from others whether I should just book the best price now? Alternatively, should I wait for possible Thai Airways sales at the end of the year?
It would be a shame if I book and prices are then heavily discounted. On the other hand, if I wait and prices increase, that would also be painful. Not sure what I should do.
